def f(g):
    # colors: bg dominant, border color, marker color (rare)
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bg]
    # marker = rarest non-bg, border = rest
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    marks={c:n for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bg}
    mark=min(marks,key=lambda c:(marks[c],c))
    for r,row in enumerate(g):
        for c,x in enumerate(row):
            if x==mark:
                out[r][c]=4
                # extend toward nearest non-bg-non-border? use horizontal toward edge
                L=c;R=c
                while c>0 and row[c-1]!=bg: c-=1; R=c-1
                c+=1
                while c<len(row)-1 and row[c+1]!=bg: c+=1; L=c+1
                for k in range(L,R+1): out[r][k]=mark
    return out

from collections import Counter

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for r in g for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    # marker = rarest non-bg, bar = rest
    items=[(c,n) for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bg]
    items.sort(key=lambda t:t[1])
    mark=items[0][0]
    barc=sum(t[1] for t in items[1:])
    # find bar cells: connected straight line(s) of barc... just cells != bg and != mark
    bar=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]!=bg and g[r][c]!=mark]
    # determine orientation: collect rows/cols counts
    rowc=Counter(r for r,c in bar); colc=Counter(c for r,c in bar)
    vertical = max(colc.values(),default=0) >= min(rowc.values(),default=0) and colc.most_common(1)[0][1] > len(set(r for r,c in bar))*1
    # simpler: if bars lie mostly in one column -> vertical else horizontal
    def isline(cells,axis):
        if axis=='r': return all(c==cells[0][1] for r,c in cells)
        return all(r==cells[0][0] for r,c in cells)
    cells=set(bar)
    vert = all(c==next(iter(cells))[1] for r,c in cells) if cells else False
    horiz = all(r==next(iter(cells))[0] for r,c in cells) if cells else False
    out=[r[:] for r in g]
    # process markers: each marker emits toward opposite bar
    marks=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if g[r][c]==mark]
    for (r,c) in marks:
        out[r][c]=4
        # direction: horizontal if bars vertical else vertical; toward the bar
        if vert:
            # bars vertical: beams horizontal, toward bar's column side
            bc=sorted(set(c for r,c in cells))
            target = bc[-1] if c < bc[0] else bc[0]
            lo,hi=(c+1,target-1) if c<target else (target+1,c-1)
            for k in range(lo,hi+1):
                if out[r][k]==bg: out[r][k]=mark
        else:
            br=sorted(set(r for r,c in cells))
            target = br[-1] if r < br[0] else br[0]
            lo,hi=(r+1,target-1) if r<target else (target+1,r-1)
            for k in range(lo,hi+1):
                if out[k][c]==bg: out[k][c]=mark
    # bars emit beams at extremal + middle rows/cols toward opposite bar
    if vert:
        rs=sorted(set(r for r,c in cells))
        for r in rs:
            lo,hi=rs[0],rs[-1]
            mid=(lo+hi)//2
            for rr in (lo,hi,mid):
                # beams from each bar cell in that row toward opposite bar
                for (rr0,c) in cells:
                    if rr0!=rr: continue
                    bc=sorted(set(c for rr_,c in cells))
                    tgt=bc[-1] if c<bc[0] else bc[0]
                    l,h=(c+1,tgt-1) if c<tgt else (tgt+1,c-1)
                    for k in range(l,h+1):
                        if out[r][k]==bg: out[r][k]=mark
    else:
        cs=sorted(set(c for r,c in cells))
        for c in cs:
            lo,hi=cs[0],cs[-1]
            for cc in (lo,hi,(lo+hi)//2):
                for (r,c_) in cells:
                    if c_!=cc: continue
                    br=sorted(set(r for r,c_ in cells))
                    tgt=br[-1] if r<br[0] else br[0]
                    l,h=(r+1,tgt-1) if r<tgt else (tgt+1,r-1)
                    for k in range(l,h+1):
                        if out[k][c_]==bg: out[k][c_]=mark
    return out

def f(a):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for r in a for x in r)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bg]
    sc=min(others,key=lambda c:-(-c))  # pick smallest
    # direction: towards nearest frame cell per stray; frame = largest non-bg color
    fc=max(others,key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    b=[r[:] for r in a]
    h,w=len(b),len(b[0])
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if b[r][c]==sc:
                best=None
                for dr,dc in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc;d=0;ok=True
                    while rr>=0 and rr<h and cc>=0 and cc<w:
                        v=b[rr][cc]
                        if v==bg: d+=1; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
                        elif v==fc: ok=False;break
                        else: ok=False;break
                    if not ok: continue
                    if (best is None or d>best[0]): best=(d,dr,dc)
                if best:
                    b[r][c]=4
                    dd,dr,dc=best
                    for k in range(dd):
                        b[r+k*dr][c+k*dc]=sc
    return b
